name: Kiyohara Chiharu
source:
Although he is male, Chiharu looks and sounds feminine. He is in charge of cleaning in the Kuonji household. As a nod, due to his less important role of the story, he is often being overlooked and forgotten by everybody.

[From [url=https://en.m.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Kimi_ga_Aruji_de_Shitsuji_ga_Ore_de&diffonly=true]Wikipedia[/url]]
